content_fields.title: Avoid dynamically loading any code without proper security considerations
content_fields.description: Constrain what the service loads at runtime to a reviewed, trusted set.
content_fields.finding: Arbitrary remote bytes are pulled in at request time and stored for later use with no source restriction.
content_fields.current_code:
def _image_url_to_base64(image_url: str):
    response = requests.get(image_url, stream=True)
    encoded_image = base64.b64encode(response.content).decode()

    return encoded_image
